title: You Shove the Orphan Away. The Same Verb Shoves You Into the Fire.
excerpt: The violent verb yadu''u ("he shoves") is used as a plain verb only twice in the Quran: active at 107:2, where a man shoves the orphan away from his right, and passive at 52:13, where the deniers are shoved into the Fire. Same verb, flipped from active to passive — and both scenes are bracketed by the root for denying the Faith.
seo_title: The Verb Used Twice: Shoving the Orphan (107:2) and the Fire (52:13)
seo_description: The Quran's verb for a violent shove, yadu''u, appears as a verb only at 107:2 (a man shoves the orphan) and 52:13 (the deniers are shoved into Hell) — active, then passive. A corpus-verified voice-flip reading of Surah Al-Ma'un and Surah At-Tur.
